WHAT’S INCLUDED

SEO management built around the data that matters.

Search visibility is not a set-and-forget task. We keep the technical essentials current and use the signals in Google Search Console to help guide your website forward.

  1. 01

    Sitemaps and Search Console

    We generate, maintain and submit your sitemap to Google Search Console, helping Google discover the pages you want customers to find.

  2. 02

    Search performance tracking

    We monitor clicks, impressions and indexed pages so you can see how your website is appearing in search and what is changing over time.

  3. 03

    Content opportunities

    We use search-query data to spot relevant keywords and shape ideas for future SEO content that answers what people are already looking for.
